name: Path Planner
description: An advanced web-based robotic path planning system that combines real-world OpenStreetMap data with sophisticated navigation algorithms (A*, Dijkstra) and PID control for tracking.

name: Maze Solver on Gazebo
description: ROS 2-based autonomous robot system for navigating and solving mazes in Gazebo simulation, featuring LiDAR-based perception, SLAM, and wall-following algorithms.

name: Autonomous Parkour Drone
description: An autonomous quadcopter system that navigates predefined courses using LiDAR, GPS, and an A* path planning algorithm with PID control in the Webots robotics simulation platform.

name: Autonomous Ackermann Model on Gazebo
description: ROS 2 autonomous racing simulation for Ackermann vehicles featuring ArUco-based topological mapping and real-time adaptive reinforcement learning to optimize lap times.
